discovery_notes: Licensed 2018 sweep via 25 search-snippet queries, mostly Disney Pins Blog with a few undated BoxLunch/Hot Topic listings. Coverage is Jul-Dec 2018 only. Cri-Kee (Jul 2018, $8.90) came from a multi-result summary; verify. Button sets (1in pinbacks) included as sets for scope review. Pink a la Mode and ArtLand had no 2018 Disney releases found. Funko multi-character sets recorded at set level only.
